source.text: וִיהוֹרָ֣ם בֶּן־אַחְאָ֗ב מָלַ֤ךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן בִּשְׁנַת֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לִיהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Jehoram son of Ahab reigned over Israel in Samaria in year eighteen of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned twelve years.

en.L: And Jehoram son of Ahab reigned over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned twelve years.
en.B: In the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Jehoram son of Ahab became king over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned twelve years.
en.R: Jehoram son of Ahab became king over Israel in the eighteenth year that Jehoshaphat was king of Judah. Jehoram ruled over Israel from Samaria for twelve years.

es.L: Y Jehoram hijo de Acab comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en Samaria en el año dieciocho de Josafat, rey de Judá, y reinó doce años.
es.B: En el año dieciocho de Josafat, rey de Judá, Jehoram hijo de Acab comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en Samaria, y reinó doce años.
es.R: Jehoram hijo de Acab llegó a ser rey de Israel en el año dieciocho del reinado de Josafat en Judá. Jehoram gobernó a Israel desde Samaria durante doce años.

fr.L: Et Yehoram fils d’Achab régna sur Israël à Samarie en la dix-huitième année de Josaphat, roi de Juda, et il régna douze ans.
fr.B: La dix-huitième année du règne de Josaphat, roi de Juda, Yehoram, fils d’Achab, devint roi d’Israël à Samarie ; il régna douze ans.
fr.R: Yehoram, fils d’Achab, est devenu roi d’Israël la dix-huitième année du règne de Josaphat, roi de Juda. Yehoram a régné sur Israël à Samarie pendant douze ans.

sw.L: Na Yehoramu mwana wa Ahabu akatawala juu ya Israeli huko Samaria katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, akatawala miaka kumi na miwili.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, Yehoramu mwana wa Ahabu alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli huko Samaria, akatawala miaka kumi na miwili.
sw.R: Yehoramu mwana wa Ahabu alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa utawala wa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda. Yehoramu alitawala Israeli akiwa Samaria kwa miaka kumi na miwili.

vi.L: Giê-hô-ram con trai A-háp cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri vào năm thứ mười tám đời Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa, và trị vì mười hai năm.
vi.B: Năm thứ mười tám đời Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa, Giê-hô-ram con trai A-háp lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri và trị vì mười hai năm.
vi.R: Giê-hô-ram con trai A-háp lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên vào năm thứ mười tám đời Giô-sa-phát làm vua Giu-đa. Giê-hô-ram cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri mười hai năm.

ko.L: 그리고 유다 왕 여호사밧 제18년에 아합의 아들 여호람이 사마리아에서 이스라엘을 다스렸고, 그가 12년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.B: 유다 왕 여호사밧이 다스린 지 18년째 되는 해에 아합의 아들 여호람이 사마리아에서 이스라엘의 왕이 되어 12년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.R: 유다 왕 여호사밧이 다스린 지 18년째 되는 해에 아합의 아들 여호람이 이스라엘의 왕이 되었다. 여호람은 사마리아에서 12년 동안 이스라엘을 다스렸다.

pt.L: E Jorão, filho de Acabe, reinou sobre Israel em Samaria no décimo oitavo ano de Josafá, rei de Judá, e reinou doze anos.
pt.B: No décimo oitavo ano de Josafá, rei de Judá, Jorão, filho de Acabe, começou a reinar sobre Israel em Samaria, e reinou doze anos.
pt.R: Jorão, filho de Acabe, se tornou rei de Israel no décimo oitavo ano do reinado de Josafá, rei de Judá. Jorão governou Israel em Samaria durante doze anos.

decisions.choice: Jehoram son of Ahab: Ahab's second son to rule Israel, also called Joram
decisions.reason: Jehoram followed his brother Ahaziah, who died without a son (1:17). The shorter form of his name, Joram, is used for him later (8:16; 9:14). He is a different man from Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat, who ruled Judah at about the same time (8:16).

decisions.choice: the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat: a date counted differently from 1:17
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 1:17 dates Jehoram's accession to the second year of Jehoram of Judah, Jehoshaphat's son. The two dates probably reflect a time when Jehoshaphat and his son ruled Judah together, so that a year could be counted from either reign. The text does not explain the difference.

decisions.choice: reigned (Literal); became king ... and he reigned (Balanced); became king ... ruled (Readable)
decisions.reason: The accession formula, worded at each level as throughout Kings (1 Kings 16:29). Balanced puts the date first, as the formula usually does; Readable splits it into two sentences.

decisions.choice: comenzó a reinar ... y reinó N años (Literal, Balanced); llegó a ser rey ... gobernó (Readable)
decisions.reason: The accession formula of the terms note, one wording per level through Kings and Chronicles; Literal keeps the Hebrew order, Balanced puts the date first, Readable splits the sentence.

decisions.choice: "régna sur Israël à Samarie en la Ne année de ..." (L); "La Ne année du règne de ..., Y devint roi d’Israël à Samarie ; il régna N ans" (B); "est devenu roi ... a régné" (R)
decisions.reason: The accession formula of the Kings terms note, used for every king of Israel in this block.

decisions.choice: "akatawala" (Literal); "alianza kutawala ... akatawala miaka N" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The accession formula takes one wording per level through Kings, as the terms note sets it: "Katika mwaka wa N wa X mfalme wa Yuda, Y mwana wa Z alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli huko Samaria, akatawala miaka N." Literal keeps the Hebrew order.

decisions.choice: "Năm thứ N đời X vua Giu-đa, Y con trai Z lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri và trị vì N năm"
decisions.reason: The accession formula in the terms note's wording, kept at each level through Kings; Literal follows the Hebrew's single verb with "cai trị".

decisions.choice: The accession formula: "유다 왕 X 제N년에" (L), "유다 왕 X가 다스린 지 N년째 되는 해에 ... 왕이 되어 N년 동안 다스렸다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note; regnal years are written in figures through this block.

decisions.choice: reinou ... no N-ésimo ano de X (L); No N-ésimo ano de X, rei de Judá, Y começou a reinar ... e reinou N anos (B); se tornou rei ... no N-ésimo ano do reinado de X ... governou ... durante N anos (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the opening formula of a king of Israel keeps one wording at each level, the one the shared rules for Kings set and 1 Kings uses in Portuguese: Literal follows the Hebrew order, Balanced puts the date first with "começou a reinar", and Readable says "se tornou rei" and "governou". The year is given with the ordinal, "no décimo oitavo ano", as 1 Kings 15:1 and 2 Kings 1:17 have it in Portuguese; "Josafá" and "Jorão" as Matthew 1:8 has them in Portuguese.

source.text: וַיַּעֲשֶׂ֤ה הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה רַ֕ק לֹ֥א כְאָבִ֖יו וּכְאִמּ֑וֹ וַיָּ֨סַר֙ אֶת־מַצְּבַ֣ת הַבַּ֔עַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, only not like his father and like his mother; and he removed [the] standing stone of the Baal which his father made.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, only not like his father and like his mother; and he removed the standing stone of the Baal that his father had made.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, though not like his father and mother. He removed the standing stone of Baal that his father had made.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil, but he was not as bad as his father and mother had been. He took away the stone pillar for the god Baal that his father had set up.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, aunque no como su padre y como su madre; y quitó la estela de Baal que su padre había hecho.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, aunque no tanto como su padre y su madre. Quitó la piedra sagrada de Baal que su padre había hecho.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba, pero no fue tan malo como lo habían sido su padre y su madre. Quitó la piedra que su padre había levantado para adorar al dios Baal.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, seulement pas comme son père et comme sa mère ; et il ôta la stèle de Baal que son père avait faite.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, mais pas autant que son père et sa mère. Il ôta la pierre dressée de Baal que son père avait faite.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais, mais il n’a pas été aussi mauvais que son père et sa mère. Il a enlevé la pierre dressée en l’honneur du dieu Baal que son père avait mise en place.

sw.L: Akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ila si kama baba yake na kama mama yake; akaiondoa nguzo ya mawe ya Baali aliyoifanya baba yake.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ingawa si kama baba yake na mama yake. Aliiondoa nguzo ya mawe ya Baali ambayo baba yake alikuwa ameifanya.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya, lakini hakuwa mbaya kama baba yake na mama yake walivyokuwa. Aliiondoa nguzo ya mawe ya mungu Baali ambayo baba yake aliisimamisha.

vi.L: Vua làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nhưng không như cha và mẹ mình; vua dẹp bỏ trụ đá của Ba-anh mà cha mình đã làm.
vi.B: Vua làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nhưng không đến nỗi như cha mẹ mình. Vua dẹp bỏ trụ đá thờ Ba-anh mà cha mình đã dựng.
vi.R: Vua làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác, nhưng không tệ như cha mẹ mình. Vua dẹp bỏ trụ đá dựng lên để thờ thần Ba-anh mà cha vua đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했으나, 그의 아버지와 그의 어머니처럼은 아니었다. 그리고 그가 그의 아버지가 만든 바알의 돌기둥을 없앴다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했으나, 그의 아버지나 어머니만큼은 아니었다. 그는 자기 아버지가 만든 바알의 돌기둥을 없앴다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다. 그러나 그의 아버지와 어머니만큼 나쁘지는 않았다. 그는 아버지가 세운 바알 신의 돌기둥을 치워 버렸다.

pt.L: E ele fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, só que não como o seu pai e como a sua mãe; e removeu a coluna sagrada de Baal que o seu pai tinha feito.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, mas não como o seu pai e a sua mãe. Removeu a coluna sagrada de Baal que o seu pai tinha feito.
pt.R: Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau, mas não foi tão mau como o seu pai e a sua mãe tinham sido. Ele tirou a coluna de pedra do deus Baal que o seu pai tinha levantado.

decisions.choice: his father and his mother: Ahab and Jezebel
decisions.reason: Ahab built a temple and altar for Baal in Samaria (1 Kings 16:32-33), and Jezebel supported Baal's prophets (1 Kings 18:19). Jezebel was still alive in Jehoram's reign (9:22, 30).

decisions.choice: the standing stone of the Baal: a sacred stone set up in Baal's honor
decisions.reason: A standing stone was an upright stone that marked a place of worship and stood for the god's presence. Removing it was a partial reform. Baal's temple stayed, and Jehu later destroyed a standing stone of Baal there (10:26-27), so Baal's worship had not ended.

decisions.choice: did the evil in [the] eyes of / did what was evil in the sight of / did what the LORD said was evil
decisions.reason: The verdict formula, worded at each level as throughout Kings (1 Kings 16:19).

decisions.choice: stone pillar for the god Baal
decisions.reason: Readable uses its usual words for standing stones and says who Baal was (1 Kings 16:31).

decisions.choice: hizo lo malo a los ojos del SEÑOR (Literal, Balanced); hizo lo que el SEÑOR reprueba (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verdict formula of the terms note, one wording per level through Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: la estela (Literal); la piedra sagrada (Balanced); la piedra ... levantado para adorar al dios Baal (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note's words for a standing stone at each level; Readable says what the stone was for and who Baal was.

decisions.choice: "fit ce qui est mal aux yeux du SEIGNEUR" (L, B); "a fait ce que le SEIGNEUR déclare mauvais" (R)
decisions.reason: The verdict formula of the Kings terms note, one wording per level for every king in this block.

decisions.choice: "la stèle" (L); "la pierre dressée" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings terms note for standing stones.

decisions.choice: "alifanya maovu machoni pa BWANA" (Literal, Balanced); "alifanya yale BWANA aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verdict formula keeps one wording per level through Kings, as the terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: "làm điều ác trước mắt CHÚA" (L); "trước mặt CHÚA" (B); "làm điều CHÚA cho là ác" (R)
decisions.reason: The verdict formula in the terms note's wording, kept at each level through Kings.

decisions.choice: "trụ đá"
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the standing stones set up in a god's honor (m2).

decisions.choice: The verdict "...의 눈에 악한 일을 했다" (L), "... 보시기에 악한 일을 했다" (B), "...께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다" (R); "돌기둥" for the standing stone
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note, which fixes one wording per level for the verdict through all four books.

decisions.choice: fez o mal aos olhos do SENHOR (L); fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR (B); fez o que o SENHOR considerava mau (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the verdict on each king keeps the wording 1 Kings 14:22 sets in Portuguese at each level, with its opposite "fez o que era reto aos olhos do SENHOR" (B) and "fez o que o SENHOR considerava certo" (R).

decisions.choice: a coluna sagrada de Baal (L, B); a coluna de pedra do deus Baal (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the standing stone (m2) takes the words of Exodus 23:24 and 34:13 in Portuguese, "coluna sagrada" at Literal and Balanced and "coluna de pedra" at Readable, which also says who Baal was, as the English Readable does.

source.text: רַ֠ק בְּחַטֹּ֞אות יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּֽן־נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דָּבֵ֑ק לֹא־סָ֖ר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Only to [the] sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat which he made sin Israel he clung; not he turned from it.

en.L: Only, to the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he made Israel sin, he clung; he did not turn from them.
en.B: Yet he held on to the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, by which he led Israel to sin; he did not turn away from them.
en.R: But he kept on committing the sins by which Jeroboam son of Nebat led Israel into sin. He did not stop.

es.L: Solamente se aferró a los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, con que hizo pecar a Israel; no se apartó de ellos.
es.B: Pero siguió aferrado a los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, que este hizo cometer a Israel; no se apartó de ellos.
es.R: Pero siguió cometiendo los pecados con los que Jeroboam hijo de Nabat hizo pecar a Israel. No dejó de hacerlo.

fr.L: Seulement, aux péchés de Jéroboam fils de Nebath, qu’il avait fait commettre à Israël, il s’attacha ; il ne s’en détourna pas.
fr.B: Pourtant il resta attaché aux péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, par lesquels celui-ci avait entraîné Israël à pécher ; il ne s’en détourna pas.
fr.R: Mais il a continué à commettre les péchés par lesquels Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, avait entraîné Israël à pécher. Il n’a pas arrêté.

sw.L: Lakini aliambatana na dhambi za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, alizowafanya Israeli kutenda; hakuziacha.
sw.B: Hata hivyo aliendelea kushikamana na dhambi za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, alizowafanya Israeli kutenda; hakuziacha.
sw.R: Lakini aliendelea kutenda dhambi zile ambazo Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati aliwafanya Israeli kutenda. Hakuacha.

vi.L: Song vua bám lấy các tội của Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, tội mà ông đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm; vua không từ bỏ chúng.
vi.B: Tuy nhiên, vua vẫn đi theo các tội của Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, tội mà ông đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm; vua không từ bỏ chúng.
vi.R: Nhưng vua cứ phạm những tội mà Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm. Vua không chịu thôi.

ko.L: 다만 느밧의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 그 죄들에 그가 매달렸고, 그것에서 떠나지 않았다.
ko.B: 그러나 그는 느밧의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄를 붙들고, 그 죄에서 떠나지 않았다.
ko.R: 그러나 그는 느밧의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘을 죄짓게 한 그 죄를 계속 지었다. 그는 그 죄를 그만두지 않았다.

pt.L: Só que aos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com os quais fez Israel pecar, ele se apegou; não se desviou deles.
pt.B: Mas ele se apegou aos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com os quais este fez Israel pecar; não se afastou deles.
pt.R: Mas ele continuou cometendo os pecados com os quais Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, levou Israel a pecar. Ele não parou.

decisions.choice: the sins of Jeroboam which he made Israel sin: the calf shrines at Bethel and Dan
decisions.reason: Jeroboam set up golden calves at Bethel and Dan and led Israel to worship there (1 Kings 12:28-33). Kings judges every king of Israel by this sin. Jehoram removed one sign of Baal worship but kept Jeroboam's shrines.

decisions.choice: clung: held fast to
decisions.reason: The verb means to stick to something closely. It is the word used for holding fast to Yahweh (Deuteronomy 10:20); here Jehoram holds fast to Jeroboam's sins instead.

decisions.choice: from it: from those sins
decisions.reason: The pronoun is singular. It treats Jeroboam's sins as one whole, the worship he set up.

decisions.choice: made Israel sin (Literal); led Israel to sin (Balanced); led Israel into sin (Readable)
decisions.reason: The formula of the sin of Jeroboam keeps one wording at each level through Kings, as set at 1 Kings 14:16: "made Israel sin" (Literal), "led Israel to sin" (Balanced), "led Israel into sin" (Readable). Later uses in this book refer back here.

decisions.choice: con que hizo pecar a Israel (Literal); que este hizo cometer a Israel (Balanced); con los que ... hizo pecar a Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: The formula of the sin of Jeroboam keeps the terms note's wording at each level through Kings.

decisions.choice: "qu’il avait fait commettre à Israël" (L); "avait entraîné Israël à pécher" (B, R)
alternatives: "qu’il avait fait commettre à Israël" at every level
decisions.reason: The Jeroboam formula of the Kings terms note; Balanced and Readable say "led Israel to sin" plainly where the sentence speaks of the sins one by one.

decisions.choice: "dhambi ... alizowafanya Israeli kutenda"
decisions.reason: The formula of the sin of Jeroboam follows the terms note at every level ("katika dhambi yake aliyowafanya Israeli kutenda"), so the recurring charge reads the same through Kings.

decisions.choice: "tội mà ông đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm"
alternatives: "tội mà ông đã dụ Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm"
decisions.reason: The formula of the sin of Jeroboam as the terms note gives it, kept through Kings; "bám lấy" at Literal is the Hebrew "clung" (m2).

decisions.choice: "여로보암이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄" for the sin of Jeroboam, with "매달렸다" (L) and "붙들고" (B) for "clung"
decisions.reason: The terms note's phrase for the sin of Jeroboam is kept; the verb here is "clung", not "walked", so Korean uses a verb of holding on.

decisions.choice: com os quais fez Israel pecar (L, B); levou Israel a pecar (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the refrain on the northern kings (m1) keeps the wording 1 Kings 14:16 sets in Portuguese, the causative "fazer pecar" at Literal and Balanced and "levar a pecar" at Readable. Literal keeps the plural "deles" for the Hebrew singular (m3), as the English Literal says "them".

source.text: וּמֵישַׁ֥ע מֶֽלֶךְ־מוֹאָ֖ב הָיָ֣ה נֹקֵ֑ד וְהֵשִׁ֤יב לְמֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאָה־אֶ֣לֶף כָּרִ֔ים וּמֵ֥אָה אֶ֖לֶף אֵילִ֥ים צָֽמֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheep-breeder, and he would deliver to [the] king of Israel a hundred thousand lambs and a hundred thousand rams, wool.

en.L: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder, and he used to deliver to the king of Israel 100,000 lambs and 100,000 rams, [their] wool.
en.B: Mesha king of Moab raised sheep, and he used to pay the king of Israel 100,000 lambs and the wool of 100,000 rams.
en.R: Mesha, the king of Moab, raised large flocks of sheep. Every year he had to give the king of Israel 100,000 lambs and the wool of 100,000 rams.

es.L: Y Mesa, rey de Moab, era criador de ovejas, y entregaba al rey de Israel cien mil corderos y cien mil carneros, [su] lana.
es.B: Mesa, rey de Moab, criaba ovejas, y pagaba al rey de Israel cien mil corderos y la lana de cien mil carneros.
es.R: Mesa, el rey de Moab, tenía grandes rebaños de ovejas. Cada año tenía que darle al rey de Israel cien mil corderos y la lana de cien mil carneros.

fr.L: Et Mésha, roi de Moab, était éleveur de moutons, et il livrait au roi d’Israël 100 000 agneaux et 100 000 béliers, [leur] laine.
fr.B: Mésha, roi de Moab, élevait des moutons, et il payait au roi d’Israël un tribut de 100 000 agneaux et de la laine de 100 000 béliers.
fr.R: Mésha, le roi de Moab, avait de grands troupeaux de moutons. Chaque année, il devait donner au roi d’Israël 100 000 agneaux et la laine de 100 000 béliers.

sw.L: Mesha mfalme wa Moabu alikuwa mfugaji wa kondoo, naye alikuwa akimletea mfalme wa Israeli wana-kondoo 100,000 na kondoo dume 100,000, [manyoya yao].
sw.B: Mesha mfalme wa Moabu alifuga kondoo, naye alikuwa akimlipa mfalme wa Israeli wana-kondoo 100,000 na manyoya ya kondoo dume 100,000.
sw.R: Mesha mfalme wa Moabu alikuwa na makundi makubwa ya kondoo. Kila mwaka alilazimika kumpa mfalme wa Israeli wana-kondoo 100,000 na manyoya ya kondoo dume 100,000.

vi.L: Mê-sa vua Mô-áp là người chăn nuôi chiên, và thường nộp cho vua Y-sơ-ra-ên 100.000 chiên con và 100.000 chiên đực, [cùng] lông của chúng.
vi.B: Mê-sa vua Mô-áp nuôi nhiều chiên, và thường phải nộp cho vua Y-sơ-ra-ên 100.000 chiên con và lông của 100.000 chiên đực.
vi.R: Mê-sa vua Mô-áp nuôi những bầy chiên rất lớn. Hằng năm ông phải nộp cho vua Y-sơ-ra-ên 100.000 chiên con và lông của 100.000 chiên đực.

ko.L: 그리고 모압 왕 메사는 양을 치는 사람이었는데, 그가 이스라엘 왕에게 어린 양 10만 마리와 숫양 10만 마리[의] 털을 바치곤 했다.
ko.B: 모압 왕 메사는 양을 많이 치는 사람이었는데, 이스라엘 왕에게 어린 양 10만 마리와 숫양 10만 마리의 털을 바치곤 했다.
ko.R: 모압 왕 메사는 양 떼를 많이 길렀다. 그는 해마다 이스라엘 왕에게 어린 양 10만 마리와 숫양 10만 마리의 털을 바쳐야 했다.

pt.L: E Mesa, rei de Moabe, era criador de ovelhas, e entregava ao rei de Israel cem mil cordeiros e cem mil carneiros, [com a] lã.
pt.B: Mesa, rei de Moabe, criava ovelhas e costumava pagar ao rei de Israel cem mil cordeiros e a lã de cem mil carneiros.
pt.R: Mesa, o rei de Moabe, criava grandes rebanhos de ovelhas. Todo ano ele tinha de dar ao rei de Israel cem mil cordeiros e a lã de cem mil carneiros.

decisions.choice: sheep breeder: an owner of large flocks
decisions.reason: The word names someone who raises sheep on a large scale. It is used of the prophet Amos (Amos 1:1). Moab's high plain east of the Dead Sea was good grazing land.

decisions.choice: he would deliver: a tribute paid again and again
decisions.reason: The verb form describes a repeated action. Moab had been under Israel's rule and paid a regular tribute in animals and wool. A Moabite inscription set up by Mesha himself, the Moabite Stone found in 1868, says that Omri and his son had oppressed Moab and that Mesha freed his land.

decisions.choice: rams, wool: the wool of the rams
alternatives: 100,000 lambs and 100,000 rams, with their wool
decisions.reason: The word "wool" stands at the end without a link word. It most likely means the wool of the 100,000 rams, though it could mean that both lambs and rams were paid with their wool.

decisions.choice: Every year he had to give
decisions.reason: Readable makes the repeated payment explicit. The Hebrew does not say how often it was paid, so "every year" goes beyond the text.

decisions.choice: "Mê-sa"
decisions.reason: The king's name in the usual Vietnamese form; "người chăn nuôi chiên" is the sheep breeder, an owner of large flocks (m1).

decisions.choice: "숫양 10만 마리의 털", reading "wool" with the rams only, as the English Balanced does; large numbers in figures
decisions.reason: The meaning decision (m3) reads the last word as the rams' wool. Literal brackets the "of" that Korean must add.

decisions.choice: Mesa, rei de Moabe; cem mil (in words)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the king (m2) takes the usual Brazilian form "Mesa", and "Moabe" keeps the form of the Pentateuch in Portuguese. Round numbers are written in words, as docs/portuguese-style.md section 5 sets it, where the English writes "100,000"; so are "setecentos" (verse 26) and "cem" (4:43).

records.literal_gloss: And it was, as died Ahab, and rebelled [the] king of Moab against [the] king of Israel.

en.L: And it was, when Ahab died, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
en.B: But when Ahab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
en.R: But after Ahab died, the king of Moab turned against the king of Israel and stopped paying.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando murió Acab, el rey de Moab se rebeló contra el rey de Israel.
es.B: Pero cuando murió Acab, el rey de Moab se rebeló contra el rey de Israel.
es.R: Pero cuando murió Acab, el rey de Moab se puso en contra del rey de Israel y dejó de pagarle.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Achab mourut, que le roi de Moab se révolta contre le roi d’Israël.
fr.B: Mais quand Achab mourut, le roi de Moab se révolta contre le roi d’Israël.
fr.R: Mais après la mort d’Achab, le roi de Moab s’est révolté contre le roi d’Israël et il a arrêté de payer.

sw.L: Ikawa, Ahabu alipokufa, mfalme wa Moabu akaasi dhidi ya mfalme wa Israeli.
sw.B: Lakini Ahabu alipokufa, mfalme wa Moabu aliasi dhidi ya mfalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Lakini baada ya Ahabu kufa, mfalme wa Moabu alimgeuka mfalme wa Israeli, akaacha kulipa.

vi.L: Khi A-háp chết, vua Mô-áp nổi loạn chống lại vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Nhưng khi A-háp qua đời, vua Mô-áp nổi loạn chống lại vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Nhưng sau khi A-háp qua đời, vua Mô-áp chống lại vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và không chịu nộp cống nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 아합이 죽었을 때에, 모압 왕이 이스라엘 왕에게 반역했다.
ko.B: 그러나 아합이 죽자, 모압 왕이 이스라엘 왕에게 반기를 들었다.
ko.R: 그런데 아합이 죽은 뒤에 모압 왕은 이스라엘 왕에게 등을 돌리고 더 이상 바치지 않았다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, quando Acabe morreu, que o rei de Moabe se rebelou contra o rei de Israel.
pt.B: Mas, quando Acabe morreu, o rei de Moabe se rebelou contra o rei de Israel.
pt.R: Mas, depois que Acabe morreu, o rei de Moabe se voltou contra o rei de Israel e parou de pagar.

decisions.choice: rebelled: the revolt already mentioned in 1:1
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 1:1 has already said that Moab rebelled after Ahab's death. The story now returns to it to tell how Israel tried to win Moab back.

decisions.choice: rebelled: broke away from the treaty
decisions.reason: The verb means to break faith with a lord or treaty partner. Here it means that Mesha refused to go on paying the tribute of verse 4.

decisions.choice: turned against ... and stopped paying
decisions.reason: Readable says what the rebellion meant in practice (m2).

source.text: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹרָ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא מִשֹּׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּפְקֹ֖ד אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

en.R: So King Jehoram left Samaria at that time and called up the whole army of Israel.

es.B: Entonces el rey Jehoram salió de Samaria y pasó revista a todo Israel.
es.R: Entonces el rey Jehoram salió de Samaria y reunió a todo el ejército de Israel.

fr.L: Et le roi Yehoram sortit de Samarie en ce jour-là, et il passa en revue tout Israël.
fr.B: Le roi Yehoram sortit donc de Samarie à ce moment-là et rassembla tout Israël.
fr.R: Alors le roi Yehoram a quitté Samarie à ce moment-là et il a appelé toute l’armée d’Israël.

sw.L: Mfalme Yehoramu akatoka Samaria siku ile, akawahesabu Israeli wote.
sw.B: Basi wakati huo mfalme Yehoramu alitoka Samaria, akawakusanya Israeli wote.
sw.R: Basi wakati huo mfalme Yehoramu aliondoka Samaria, akaliita jeshi lote la Israeli.

vi.L: Vào ngày đó, vua Giê-hô-ram ra khỏi Sa-ma-ri và kiểm điểm toàn thể Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vậy lúc ấy vua Giê-hô-ram kéo quân ra khỏi Sa-ma-ri và huy động toàn thể Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vậy lúc ấy vua Giê-hô-ram rời Sa-ma-ri và kêu gọi toàn quân Y-sơ-ra-ên ra trận.

ko.L: 그리고 그날에 여호람 왕이 사마리아에서 나가서 온 이스라엘을 소집했다.
ko.B: 그래서 그때 여호람 왕이 사마리아에서 나가서 온 이스라엘을 소집했다.
ko.R: 그래서 여호람 왕은 그때 사마리아를 떠나 이스라엘의 온 군대를 불러 모았다.

pt.L: E o rei Jorão saiu de Samaria naquele dia e passou em revista todo o Israel.
pt.B: Então, naquela ocasião, o rei Jorão saiu de Samaria e convocou todo o Israel.
pt.R: Então, naquela ocasião, o rei Jorão saiu de Samaria e convocou todo o exército de Israel.

decisions.choice: on that day: at that time
decisions.reason: "On that day" here means "at that time", when Moab rebelled, not a single day.

decisions.choice: mustered all Israel: counted and called up the fighting men
decisions.reason: The verb means to count or review, and here to gather the men fit for war.

decisions.choice: called up the whole army of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says that "all Israel" here means the fighting men (m2).

source.text: וַיֵּ֡לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֨ט מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר מֶ֤לֶךְ מוֹאָב֙ פָּשַׁ֣ע בִּ֔י הֲתֵלֵ֥ךְ אִתִּ֛י אֶל־מוֹאָ֖ב לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶעֱלֶ֔ה כָּמ֧וֹנִי כָמ֛וֹךָ כְּעַמִּ֥י כְעַמֶּ֖ךָ כְּסוּסַ֥י כְּסוּסֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat king of Judah saying, [the] king of Moab has rebelled against me; will you go with me against Moab for the battle? And he said, I will go up; as me as you, as my people as your people, as my horses as your horses.

en.L: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, saying, "The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle?" And he said, "I will go up. As I [am], so [are] you; as my people, so your people; as my horses, so your horses."
en.B: He also sent word to Jehoshaphat king of Judah. "The king of Moab," he said, "has rebelled against me. Will you join me in battle against Moab?" Jehoshaphat answered, "I will go. I am as you are, my troops are as your troops, my horses as your horses."
en.R: He sent a message to Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah. It said, "The king of Moab has turned against me. Will you come with me and fight Moab?" Jehoshaphat answered, "I will go. I am with you all the way. My army and my horses are yours to command."

es.L: Y fue y envió a decir a Josafat, rey de Judá: «El rey de Moab se ha rebelado contra mí. ¿Irás conmigo a la guerra contra Moab?». Y él dijo: «Subiré. Como yo, así tú; como mi pueblo, así tu pueblo; como mis caballos, así tus caballos».
es.B: También envió un mensaje a Josafat, rey de Judá: «El rey de Moab se ha rebelado contra mí. ¿Vendrás conmigo a pelear contra Moab?». Josafat respondió: «Iré. Yo soy como tú, mis tropas como tus tropas, mis caballos como tus caballos».
es.R: Le envió un mensaje a Josafat, el rey de Judá. Decía: «El rey de Moab se ha puesto en contra mía. ¿Vienes conmigo a pelear contra Moab?». Josafat respondió: «Iré. Estoy contigo en todo. Mi ejército y mis caballos están a tus órdenes».

fr.L: Et il alla et envoya [dire] à Josaphat, roi de Juda : « Le roi de Moab s’est révolté contre moi. Viendras-tu avec moi contre Moab pour la bataille ? » Et il dit : « Je monterai. Moi comme toi, mon peuple comme ton peuple, mes chevaux comme tes chevaux. »
fr.B: Il envoya aussi dire à Josaphat, roi de Juda : « Le roi de Moab s’est révolté contre moi. Veux-tu venir avec moi combattre Moab ? » Josaphat répondit : « J’irai. Il en sera de moi comme de toi, de mes troupes comme de tes troupes, de mes chevaux comme de tes chevaux. »
fr.R: Il a envoyé un message à Josaphat, le roi de Juda : « Le roi de Moab s’est révolté contre moi. Veux-tu venir avec moi attaquer Moab ? » Josaphat a répondu : « J’irai. Je suis avec toi jusqu’au bout. Mon armée et mes chevaux sont à tes ordres. »

sw.L: Akaenda, akatuma kwa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, akisema, "Mfalme wa Moabu ameasi dhidi yangu. Je, utakwenda pamoja nami kupigana na Moabu?" Akasema, "Nitapanda. Mimi [ni] kama wewe, watu wangu kama watu wako, farasi wangu kama farasi wako."
sw.B: Pia alituma ujumbe kwa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, akasema, "Mfalme wa Moabu ameasi dhidi yangu. Je, utaungana nami kupigana na Moabu?" Yehoshafati akajibu, "Nitakwenda. Mimi ni kama wewe, askari wangu ni kama askari wako, farasi wangu kama farasi wako."
sw.R: Alimtumia Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda ujumbe, akisema, "Mfalme wa Moabu amenigeuka. Je, utakuja pamoja nami kupigana na Moabu?" Yehoshafati akajibu, "Nitakwenda. Niko pamoja nawe kabisa. Jeshi langu na farasi wangu wako tayari kwa amri yako."

vi.L: Vua đi và sai người đến nói với Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa: "Vua Mô-áp đã nổi loạn chống lại tôi. Ông có đi với tôi đánh Mô-áp không?" Giô-sa-phát nói: "Tôi sẽ đi. Tôi cũng như ông, dân tôi cũng như dân ông, ngựa tôi cũng như ngựa ông."
vi.B: Vua cũng sai người đến nói với Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa: "Vua Mô-áp đã nổi loạn chống lại tôi. Ông có cùng tôi ra trận đánh Mô-áp không?" Giô-sa-phát đáp: "Tôi sẽ đi. Tôi với ông là một, quân tôi cũng là quân ông, ngựa tôi cũng là ngựa ông."
vi.R: Vua sai người đem thư đến cho Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa: "Vua Mô-áp đã chống lại tôi. Ông có đi với tôi đánh Mô-áp không?" Giô-sa-phát trả lời: "Tôi sẽ đi. Tôi sát cánh với ông đến cùng. Quân đội và ngựa của tôi đều sẵn sàng theo lệnh ông."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 가서 유다 왕 여호사밧에게 사람을 보내어 말했다. "모압 왕이 내게 반역했소. 당신이 나와 함께 모압을 치러 전쟁에 가겠소?" 그러자 그가 말했다. "내가 올라가겠소. 나는 당신과 같고, 내 백성은 당신의 백성과 같고, 내 말들은 당신의 말들과 같소."
ko.B: 그는 또 유다 왕 여호사밧에게 사람을 보내어 말했다. "모압 왕이 내게 반기를 들었소. 나와 함께 모압을 치러 가겠소?" 여호사밧이 대답했다. "가겠소. 나는 당신과 한마음이오. 내 군대도 당신의 군대와 같고, 내 말들도 당신의 말들과 같소."
ko.R: 그는 유다 왕 여호사밧에게 사람을 보내어 말을 전했다. "모압 왕이 나에게 등을 돌렸소. 나와 함께 모압과 싸우러 가겠소?" 여호사밧이 대답했다. "가겠소. 나는 끝까지 당신과 함께하겠소. 내 군대와 내 말들도 당신 뜻대로 쓰시오."

pt.L: E ele foi e mandou dizer a Josafá, rei de Judá: "O rei de Moabe se rebelou contra mim. Você irá comigo contra Moabe para a batalha?" E ele disse: "Subirei. Como eu, [assim é] você; como o meu povo, o seu povo; como os meus cavalos, os seus cavalos."
pt.B: Ele também enviou uma mensagem a Josafá, rei de Judá. "O rei de Moabe", disse ele, "se rebelou contra mim. Você vai comigo lutar contra Moabe?" Josafá respondeu: "Eu vou. Eu sou como você, as minhas tropas são como as suas tropas, os meus cavalos como os seus cavalos."
pt.R: Ele mandou uma mensagem a Josafá, o rei de Judá. A mensagem dizia: "O rei de Moabe se voltou contra mim. Você vem comigo lutar contra Moabe?" Josafá respondeu: "Eu vou. Estou com você até o fim. O meu exército e os meus cavalos estão às suas ordens."

decisions.choice: as I am, so are you: the same pledge Jehoshaphat gave Ahab
decisions.reason: Jehoshaphat answers Ahab's son in the words he used to Ahab before the battle at Ramoth-gilead (1 Kings 22:4), where Ahab died. Here he adds "I will go up", and he does not ask for a word from Yahweh until the army is in trouble (verse 11), unlike 1 Kings 22:5.

decisions.choice: as I am, so are you ...: I am fully with you; all I have is at your disposal
decisions.reason: A set saying of alliance, as in 1 Kings 22:4: Jehoshaphat puts himself, his army and his chariot horses on the same footing as Jehoram's.

decisions.choice: my people: my army
decisions.reason: Here "people" means the fighting men a king leads into battle (1 Kings 22:4).

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 22:4
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable reuse the wording of 1 Kings 22:4 at each level, where the Hebrew is the same: Balanced "troops", Readable "army" and the saying explained. Balanced and Readable say "go" for "go up".

decisions.choice: Jehoshaphat answered
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker, as the context makes clear.

decisions.choice: the two kings say "tôi" and "ông" to each other
decisions.reason: Allied kings speak as equals, politely; neither is the other's subject.

decisions.choice: The two kings speak to each other in 하오체 with "당신"
decisions.reason: Kings of two kingdoms speak as equals; 하오체 is the dignified address between grown men of rank.

decisions.choice: você (king to king); Como eu, [assim é] você (L); Eu sou como você ... as minhas tropas ... (B); Estou com você até o fim (R)
decisions.reason: The two kings speak to each other as equals, with "você". Jehoshaphat's pledge (m1, m2) repeats his words to Ahab in 1 Kings 22:4, and its Portuguese is meant to be the same at each level there; "o meu povo" is Literal for the army (m3), which Balanced calls "as minhas tropas" and Readable "o meu exército".

source.text: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֵי־זֶ֥ה הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ נַעֲלֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר אֱדֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, where? this the way [which] we will go up? And he said, [the] way of [the] wilderness of Edom.

en.L: And he said, "Which way shall we go up?" And he said, "The way of the wilderness of Edom."
en.B: Then he asked, "By which route shall we attack?" He answered, "By the road through the wilderness of Edom."
en.R: Then one king asked, "Which way should we go to attack?" The other answered, "We will go through the desert of Edom."

es.L: Y dijo: «¿Por cuál camino subiremos?». Y él dijo: «Por el camino del desierto de Edom».
es.B: Luego preguntó: «¿Por qué ruta atacaremos?». Él respondió: «Por el camino del desierto de Edom».
es.R: Luego uno de los reyes preguntó: «¿Por dónde vamos a ir para atacar?». El otro respondió: «Iremos por el desierto de Edom».

fr.L: Et il dit : « Par quel chemin monterons-nous ? » Et il dit : « Le chemin du désert d’Édom. »
fr.B: Puis il demanda : « Par quelle route attaquerons-nous ? » L’autre répondit : « Par la route du désert d’Édom. »
fr.R: Puis l’un des rois a demandé : « Par où devons-nous passer pour attaquer ? » L’autre a répondu : « Nous passerons par le désert d’Édom. »

sw.L: Akasema, "Tupande kwa njia ipi?" Akasema, "Njia ya jangwa la Edomu."
sw.B: Kisha akauliza, "Tushambulie kwa njia ipi?" Akajibu, "Kwa njia ya jangwa la Edomu."
sw.R: Kisha mfalme mmoja akauliza, "Tupite njia gani ili tuwashambulie?" Yule mwingine akajibu, "Tutapita katika jangwa la Edomu."

vi.L: Vua nói: "Chúng ta sẽ đi lên theo đường nào?" Vua kia nói: "Theo đường hoang mạc Ê-đôm."
vi.B: Rồi vua hỏi: "Chúng ta sẽ tiến đánh theo đường nào?" Vua kia đáp: "Theo con đường xuyên qua hoang mạc Ê-đôm."
vi.R: Một vua hỏi: "Chúng ta nên đi đường nào để tấn công?" Vua kia trả lời: "Chúng ta sẽ đi qua hoang mạc Ê-đôm."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 말했다. "우리가 어느 길로 올라가겠소?" 그러자 그가 말했다. "에돔 광야 길이오."
ko.B: 그가 물었다. "어느 길로 쳐들어가겠소?" 그가 대답했다. "에돔 광야를 지나는 길로 갑시다."
ko.R: 한 왕이 물었다. "어느 길로 쳐들어가면 좋겠소?" 다른 왕이 대답했다. "에돔 광야를 지나서 갑시다."

pt.L: E ele disse: "Por qual caminho subiremos?" E ele disse: "Pelo caminho do deserto de Edom."
pt.B: Então ele perguntou: "Por qual caminho vamos atacar?" E ele respondeu: "Pelo caminho do deserto de Edom."
pt.R: Então um dos reis perguntou: "Por onde vamos para atacar?" O outro respondeu: "Vamos pelo deserto de Edom."

decisions.choice: he said ... he said: the speakers are not named
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not say who asks and who answers. Either Jehoshaphat asks and Jehoram chooses the route, or the other way round. Both readings are possible.

decisions.choice: the way of the wilderness of Edom: around the south end of the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: This route led from Judah south around the Dead Sea and through the dry land of Edom, so that the army could enter Moab from the south rather than across the Jordan from the north. It was long and had little water (verse 9).

decisions.choice: go up: march to attack
decisions.reason: "Go up" is a common way of speaking of going out to war against a place.

decisions.choice: one king ... the other
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the two kings are speaking, without choosing which one is which (m1).

decisions.choice: "vua kia"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese needs a subject for the second speaker; "vua kia" leaves unsaid which king answers, as the Hebrew does (m1).

source.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּמֶֽלֶך־יְהוּדָה֙וּמֶ֣לֶךְ אֱד֔וֹם וַיָּסֹ֕בּוּ דֶּ֖רֶךְ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְלֹא־הָיָ֨ה מַ֧יִם לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֛ה וְלַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And went [the] king of Israel and [the] king of Judah and [the] king of Edom, and they went around a way of seven days, and not there was water for the camp and for the animals which [were] at their feet.

en.L: And the king of Israel and the king of Judah and the king of Edom went, and they went around on a way of seven days, and there was no water for the camp or for the animals that [were] at their feet.
en.B: So the king of Israel set out with the king of Judah and the king of Edom. After a roundabout march of seven days, there was no water left for the army or for the animals that followed them.
en.R: So the three kings, of Israel, Judah and Edom, set out together. They marched for seven days along a roundabout route. Then they ran out of water for the soldiers and for the animals that came with them.

es.L: Y fueron el rey de Israel y el rey de Judá y el rey de Edom, y dieron un rodeo de siete días de camino, y no había agua para el campamento ni para los animales que [iban] tras ellos.
es.B: Así salió el rey de Israel con el rey de Judá y el rey de Edom. Después de dar un rodeo de siete días, no les quedaba agua para el ejército ni para los animales que los seguían.
es.R: Así que los tres reyes, el de Israel, el de Judá y el de Edom, salieron juntos. Marcharon siete días dando un rodeo. Entonces se les acabó el agua para los soldados y para los animales que llevaban.

fr.L: Et le roi d’Israël, le roi de Juda et le roi d’Édom partirent, et ils firent un détour de sept jours de chemin, et il n’y eut pas d’eau pour le camp ni pour les bêtes qui [étaient] à leurs pieds.
fr.B: Le roi d’Israël se mit donc en route avec le roi de Juda et le roi d’Édom. Après un détour de sept jours de marche, il n’y eut plus d’eau pour l’armée ni pour les bêtes qui la suivaient.
fr.R: Les trois rois, celui d’Israël, celui de Juda et celui d’Édom, sont donc partis ensemble. Ils ont marché pendant sept jours en faisant un grand détour. Alors il n’y a plus eu d’eau pour les soldats ni pour les animaux qui les accompagnaient.

sw.L: Mfalme wa Israeli na mfalme wa Yuda na mfalme wa Edomu wakaenda, wakazunguka njia ya siku saba, wala hapakuwa na maji kwa ajili ya kambi wala kwa ajili ya wanyama waliokuwa miguuni mwao.
sw.B: Basi mfalme wa Israeli aliondoka pamoja na mfalme wa Yuda na mfalme wa Edomu. Baada ya kuzunguka kwa siku saba, hapakuwa na maji yaliyobaki kwa ajili ya jeshi wala kwa ajili ya wanyama waliowafuata.
sw.R: Basi wafalme watatu, wa Israeli, wa Yuda na wa Edomu, wakaondoka pamoja. Walitembea kwa siku saba wakipita njia ya kuzunguka. Kisha maji yakawaishia, wala hapakuwa na maji kwa askari wala kwa wanyama waliokuja pamoja nao.

vi.L: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, vua Giu-đa và vua Ê-đôm cùng đi, và họ đi vòng một quãng đường bảy ngày, và không có nước cho trại quân và cho các thú vật đi theo họ.
vi.B: Vậy vua Y-sơ-ra-ên lên đường cùng với vua Giu-đa và vua Ê-đôm. Sau bảy ngày đi đường vòng, quân đội và các thú vật đi theo họ không còn nước uống.
vi.R: Vậy ba vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, Giu-đa và Ê-đôm cùng lên đường. Họ đi đường vòng suốt bảy ngày. Rồi quân lính và các thú vật đi theo họ hết nước uống.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕과 유다 왕과 에돔 왕이 갔고, 그들이 칠 일 길을 돌아갔는데, 진영과 그들의 발에 있는 짐승들을 위한 물이 없었다.
ko.B: 그래서 이스라엘 왕은 유다 왕과 에돔 왕과 함께 길을 떠났다. 그들이 이레 동안 길을 돌아서 행군하자, 군대와 그들을 따르는 짐승들이 마실 물이 떨어졌다.
ko.R: 그래서 이스라엘과 유다와 에돔의 세 왕이 함께 길을 떠났다. 그들은 먼 길을 돌아서 이레 동안 행군했다. 그러자 군인들과 함께 온 짐승들이 마실 물이 다 떨어졌다.

pt.L: E o rei de Israel, e o rei de Judá, e o rei de Edom foram, e deram a volta por um caminho de sete dias, e não havia água para o acampamento nem para os animais que [estavam] aos seus pés.
pt.B: Assim o rei de Israel partiu com o rei de Judá e o rei de Edom. Depois de uma marcha de sete dias, dando a volta, não havia mais água para o exército nem para os animais que os seguiam.
pt.R: Então os três reis, de Israel, de Judá e de Edom, partiram juntos. Eles marcharam sete dias por um caminho que dava uma grande volta. Então acabou a água para os soldados e para os animais que iam com eles.

decisions.choice: the king of Edom: a ruler under Judah's control
decisions.reason: In Jehoshaphat's time Edom had no king of its own but a deputy who served as king (1 Kings 22:48), and Edom broke free from Judah only later (8:20). This king of Edom was probably that ruler, joining the march as Judah's ally.

decisions.choice: they went around a way of seven days: they took a roundabout route for seven days
decisions.reason: The verb means to go around. The march went the long way round, through dry country, and lasted seven days.

decisions.choice: the animals at their feet: the animals that followed them
decisions.reason: "At their feet" means following behind them. These were the pack animals and the livestock that went with the army.

decisions.choice: the camp: the army in its camp
decisions.reason: The word for a camp is often used for the army itself.

decisions.choice: army / soldiers; followed them / came with them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "camp" and "at their feet" mean (m3, m4).

decisions.choice: los animales que [iban] tras ellos
alternatives: los animales que [estaban] a sus pies
decisions.reason: "A sus pies" would read in Spanish as lying at their feet; Literal says the animals went after them, which is what the Hebrew phrase means (m3).

source.text: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲהָ֕הּ כִּֽי־קָרָ֣א יְהוָ֗ה לִשְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת֙הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לָתֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖ם בְּיַד־מוֹאָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And said [the] king of Israel, alas! for has called Yahweh the three kings the these to give them into [the] hand of Moab.

en.L: And the king of Israel said, "Alas! For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has called these three kings to give them into the hand of Moab."
en.B: The king of Israel said, "How terrible! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has called these three kings together to hand them over to Moab."
en.R: The king of Israel cried out, "This is terrible! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has brought these three kings out here to let Moab defeat them!"

es.L: Y dijo el rey de Israel: «¡Ay! Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha llamado a estos tres reyes para entregarlos en mano de Moab».
es.B: El rey de Israel dijo: «¡Qué desgracia! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha reunido a estos tres reyes para entregarlos a Moab».
es.R: El rey de Israel gritó: «¡Esto es terrible! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha traído aquí a estos tres reyes para que Moab los derrote».

fr.L: Et le roi d’Israël dit : « Hélas ! Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a appelé ces trois rois pour les livrer aux mains de Moab. »
fr.B: Le roi d’Israël dit : « Malheur ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a appelé ces trois rois pour les livrer à Moab. »
fr.R: Le roi d’Israël s’est écrié : « C’est terrible ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait venir ces trois rois ici pour que Moab les batte ! »

sw.L: Mfalme wa Israeli akasema, "Ole! Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewaita wafalme hawa watatu ili awatie mkononi mwa Moabu."
sw.B: Mfalme wa Israeli akasema, "Ni msiba ulioje! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewaita wafalme hawa watatu pamoja ili awatie mikononi mwa Moabu."
sw.R: Mfalme wa Israeli akalia, "Haya ni mabaya sana! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewaleta wafalme hawa watatu huku ili Moabu wawashinde!"

vi.L: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên nói: "Than ôi! Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã gọi ba vua này đến để phó họ vào tay Mô-áp."
vi.B: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên nói: "Thật khủng khiếp! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã gọi ba vua này đến đây để phó họ vào tay Mô-áp."
vi.R: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên kêu lên: "Thật là khủng khiếp! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đem ba vua này ra đây để cho Mô-áp đánh bại!"

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕이 말했다. "아아! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 세 왕을 불러 모압의 손에 넘기시려고 하신다."
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕이 말했다. "큰일 났구나! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 세 왕을 불러 모아 모압의 손에 넘기시려는구나."
ko.R: 이스라엘 왕이 소리쳤다. "이제 큰일 났다! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 세 왕을 이곳까지 끌고 오셔서 모압에게 지게 하시려는구나!"

pt.L: E o rei de Israel disse: "Ai! Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} chamou estes três reis para entregá-los na mão de Moabe."
pt.B: O rei de Israel disse: "Que desgraça! {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} chamou estes três reis para entregá-los a Moabe."
pt.R: O rei de Israel gritou: "Que desgraça! {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} trouxe estes três reis até aqui para deixar que Moabe os derrote!"

decisions.choice: alas! for: a cry of despair, then its reason
decisions.reason: The cry expresses dismay. The word after it gives the reason: the king believes the lack of water is Yahweh's doing.

decisions.choice: Yahweh has called these three kings to give them into the hand of Moab
decisions.reason: Jehoram blames Yahweh for the disaster, though he has not asked Yahweh anything before setting out. To give someone into another's hand means to let the enemy defeat them (verse 18). Elisha's answer will turn the same words around: Yahweh will give Moab into their hand.

decisions.choice: How terrible! / This is terrible!
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the cry "alas" in everyday words. Literal keeps "Alas".

decisions.choice: hand them over to Moab / let Moab defeat them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "give into the hand" means, as in 1 Kings 20:13.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט הַאֵ֨ין פֹּ֤ה נָבִיא֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְנִדְרְשָׁ֥ה אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה מֵאוֹת֑וֹ וַ֠יַּעַן אֶחָ֞ד מֵעַבְדֵ֤י מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר פֹּ֚ה אֱלִישָׁ֣ע בֶּן־שָׁפָ֔ט אֲשֶׁר־יָ֥צַק מַ֖יִם עַל־יְדֵ֥י אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Jehoshaphat, is there not here a prophet of Yahweh, and we may inquire of Yahweh from him? And answered one of [the] servants of [the] king of Israel and said, here [is] Elisha son of Shaphat, who poured water on [the] hands of Elijah.

en.L: And Jehoshaphat said, "Is there not here a prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that we may inquire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} through him?" And one of the servants of the king of Israel answered and said, "Elisha son of Shaphat [is] here, who poured water on the hands of Elijah."
en.B: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there no prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} here, through whom we can inquire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?" One of the king of Israel's officials answered, "Elisha son of Shaphat is here, the man who used to pour water on Elijah's hands."
en.R: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there not a prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} here? We could ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} what to do through him." One of the king of Israel's officials answered, "Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He was Elijah's personal helper."

es.L: Y dijo Josafat: «¿No hay aquí un profeta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para que consultemos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por medio de él?». Y respondió uno de los siervos del rey de Israel y dijo: «Aquí [está] Eliseo hijo de Safat, que echaba agua en las manos de Elías».
es.B: Pero Josafat preguntó: «¿No hay aquí ningún profeta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} por medio del cual podamos consultar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}?». Uno de los oficiales del rey de Israel respondió: «Aquí está Eliseo hijo de Safat, el que echaba agua en las manos de Elías».
es.R: Pero Josafat preguntó: «¿No hay aquí un profeta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? Por medio de él podríamos preguntarle {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} qué hacer». Uno de los oficiales del rey de Israel respondió: «Aquí está Eliseo hijo de Safat. Él era el ayudante personal de Elías».

fr.L: Et Josaphat dit : « N’y a-t-il pas ici un prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, par qui nous puissions consulter {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? » Et l’un des serviteurs du roi d’Israël répondit et dit : « Il y a ici Élisée fils de Shaphath, qui versait l’eau sur les mains d’Élie. »
fr.B: Mais Josaphat demanda : « N’y a-t-il pas ici un prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, par qui nous pourrions consulter {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? » L’un des officiers du roi d’Israël répondit : « Élisée, fils de Shaphath, est ici, lui qui versait l’eau sur les mains d’Élie. »
fr.R: Mais Josaphat a demandé : « N’y a-t-il pas ici un prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? Par lui, nous pourrions demander {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ce qu’il faut faire. » L’un des officiers du roi d’Israël a répondu : « Élisée, fils de Shaphath, est ici. C’était l’aide personnel d’Élie. »

sw.L: Yehoshafati akasema, "Je, hapa hakuna nabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili tumwulize {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kupitia yeye?" Mmoja wa watumishi wa mfalme wa Israeli akajibu, akasema, "Elisha mwana wa Shafati [yuko] hapa, aliyekuwa akimimina maji mikononi mwa Eliya."
sw.B: Lakini Yehoshafati akauliza, "Je, hakuna nabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hapa, ambaye kupitia yeye tunaweza kumwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?" Mmoja wa maafisa wa mfalme wa Israeli akajibu, "Elisha mwana wa Shafati yuko hapa, yule aliyekuwa akimimina maji mikononi mwa Eliya."
sw.R: Lakini Yehoshafati akauliza, "Je, hakuna nabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hapa? Kupitia yeye tungemwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tufanye nini." Mmoja wa maafisa wa mfalme wa Israeli akajibu, "Elisha mwana wa Shafati yuko hapa. Yeye alikuwa msaidizi wa karibu wa Eliya."

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát nói: "Ở đây không có một nhà tiên tri nào của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để chúng ta nhờ người cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sao?" Một trong các đầy tớ của vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đáp: "Ê-li-sê con trai Sa-phát ở đây, là người đã đổ nước trên tay Ê-li."
vi.B: Nhưng Giô-sa-phát hỏi: "Ở đây không có nhà tiên tri nào của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để chúng ta nhờ người cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sao?" Một trong các quần thần của vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đáp: "Có Ê-li-sê con trai Sa-phát ở đây, là người trước kia vẫn đổ nước rửa tay cho Ê-li."
vi.R: Nhưng Giô-sa-phát hỏi: "Ở đây không có nhà tiên tri nào của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sao? Nhờ người ấy, chúng ta có thể hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} xem phải làm gì." Một trong các quần thần của vua Y-sơ-ra-ên trả lời: "Có Ê-li-sê con trai Sa-phát ở đây. Ông ấy từng là người phụ tá riêng của Ê-li."

ko.L: 그리고 여호사밧이 말했다. "여기에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자가 없소? 우리가 그를 통해 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭐 수 있을 텐데." 그러자 이스라엘 왕의 신하들 가운데 하나가 대답하여 말했다. "엘리야의 손에 물을 붓던 사밧의 아들 엘리사가 여기 있습니다."

ko.R: 그러자 여호사밧이 물었다. "여기에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자가 없소? 그를 통해 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 어떻게 해야 할지 여쭈어 볼 수 있을 텐데." 이스라엘 왕의 신하 가운데 하나가 대답했다. "사밧의 아들 엘리사가 여기 있습니다. 그는 엘리야를 곁에서 시중들던 사람입니다."

pt.L: E Josafá disse: "Não há aqui um profeta {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para que consultemos {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} por meio dele?" E um dos servos do rei de Israel respondeu e disse: "Eliseu, filho de Safate, [está] aqui, que derramava água sobre as mãos de Elias."
pt.B: Mas Josafá perguntou: "Não há aqui nenhum profeta {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} por meio de quem possamos consultar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}?" Um dos oficiais do rei de Israel respondeu: "Eliseu, filho de Safate, está aqui, o homem que derramava água nas mãos de Elias."
pt.R: Mas Josafá perguntou: "Não há aqui um profeta {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Poderíamos perguntar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} o que fazer por meio dele." Um dos oficiais do rei de Israel respondeu: "Eliseu, filho de Safate, está aqui. Ele era o ajudante pessoal de Elias."

decisions.choice: is there not here a prophet of Yahweh?: Jehoshaphat's question at Ramoth-gilead
decisions.reason: Jehoshaphat asked almost the same question before the battle in which Ahab died (1 Kings 22:7). Then as now, he wants a true prophet of Yahweh to say what Yahweh will do.

decisions.choice: inquire of Yahweh through him: ask Yahweh for guidance by a prophet
decisions.reason: Kings asked Yahweh before or during a war whether to go on and whether they would win, usually through a prophet (1 Kings 22:5, 8).

decisions.choice: who poured water on the hands of Elijah: who served Elijah as his attendant
decisions.reason: A servant poured water over his master's hands for washing. The phrase means that Elisha was Elijah's personal attendant (1 Kings 19:21). It tells the kings that Elisha carries on Elijah's work (2:9-15).

decisions.choice: the servants of the king of Israel: his officials
decisions.reason: The king's "servants" are the officers of his court and army.

decisions.choice: officials
decisions.reason: As in these books, the king's servants are "officials" at Balanced and Readable; Literal keeps "servants".

decisions.choice: He used to be Elijah's personal helper

decisions.choice: siervos (Literal); oficiales (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The king's servants are "siervos" at Literal and "oficiales" at Balanced and Readable, as in the Spanish of Samuel.

decisions.reason: The Samuel note's wording for the king's servants, his officials (m4).

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈다" for inquiring of the LORD
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note; "여쭈다" is the humble verb for asking a superior.

decisions.choice: Eliseu, filho de Safate; que derramava água sobre as mãos de Elias (L, B); o ajudante pessoal de Elias (R)

Literal and Balanced keep the picture of pouring water (m3), and Readable says what it means, as the English levels do.

records.literal_gloss: And said Elisha to [the] king of Israel, what [is] to me and to you? Go to [the] prophets of your father and to [the] prophets of your mother. And said to him [the] king of Israel, no, for has called Yahweh the three kings the these to give them into [the] hand of Moab.

en.L: And Elisha said to the king of Israel, "What [is there] to me and to you? Go to the prophets of your father and to the prophets of your mother." And the king of Israel said to him, "No, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has called these three kings to give them into the hand of Moab."
en.B: Elisha said to the king of Israel, "What do you and I have to do with each other? Go to your father's prophets and your mother's prophets." But the king of Israel said to him, "No, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has called these three kings together to hand them over to Moab."
en.R: Elisha said to the king of Israel, "Why should I help you? Go to the prophets your father and mother listened to!" But the king of Israel answered, "No! It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who has brought these three kings out here to let Moab defeat them."

es.L: Y Eliseo dijo al rey de Israel: «¿Qué [hay] entre tú y yo? Ve a los profetas de tu padre y a los profetas de tu madre». Y el rey de Israel le dijo: «No, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha llamado a estos tres reyes para entregarlos en mano de Moab».
es.B: Eliseo le dijo al rey de Israel: «¿Qué tengo yo que ver contigo? Ve a los profetas de tu padre y a los profetas de tu madre». Pero el rey de Israel le dijo: «No, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha reunido a estos tres reyes para entregarlos a Moab».
es.R: Eliseo le dijo al rey de Israel: «¿Por qué tendría yo que ayudarte? ¡Ve a los profetas a los que escuchaban tu padre y tu madre!». Pero el rey de Israel respondió: «¡No! Es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien ha traído aquí a estos tres reyes para que Moab los derrote».

fr.L: Et Élisée dit au roi d’Israël : « Qu’y a-t-il entre moi et toi ? Va vers les prophètes de ton père et vers les prophètes de ta mère. » Et le roi d’Israël lui dit : « Non, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a appelé ces trois rois pour les livrer aux mains de Moab. »
fr.B: Élisée dit au roi d’Israël : « Qu’avons-nous à faire ensemble, toi et moi ? Va trouver les prophètes de ton père et les prophètes de ta mère. » Mais le roi d’Israël lui dit : « Non, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a appelé ces trois rois pour les livrer à Moab. »
fr.R: Élisée a dit au roi d’Israël : « Pourquoi est-ce que je t’aiderais ? Va voir les prophètes que ton père et ta mère écoutaient ! » Mais le roi d’Israël a répondu : « Non ! C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui a fait venir ces trois rois ici pour que Moab les batte. »

sw.B: Elisha akamwambia mfalme wa Israeli, "Mimi na wewe tuna uhusiano gani? Nenda kwa manabii wa baba yako na manabii wa mama yako." Lakini mfalme wa Israeli akamwambia, "Hapana, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewaita wafalme hawa watatu pamoja ili awatie mikononi mwa Moabu."
sw.R: Elisha akamwambia mfalme wa Israeli, "Kwa nini nikusaidie? Nenda kwa manabii wale ambao baba yako na mama yako waliwasikiliza!" Lakini mfalme wa Israeli akajibu, "Hapana! Ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyewaleta wafalme hawa watatu huku ili Moabu wawashinde."

vi.B: Ê-li-sê nói với vua Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Tôi với vua có liên quan gì với nhau? Vua hãy đi đến các nhà tiên tri của cha vua và các nhà tiên tri của mẹ vua." Nhưng vua Y-sơ-ra-ên nói với ông: "Không, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã gọi ba vua này đến để phó họ vào tay Mô-áp."
vi.R: Ê-li-sê nói với vua Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Tại sao tôi phải giúp vua? Vua hãy đi đến với các nhà tiên tri mà cha mẹ vua vẫn nghe theo!" Nhưng vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đáp: "Không! Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đem ba vua này ra đây để cho Mô-áp đánh bại."

ko.L: 그리고 엘리사가 이스라엘 왕에게 말했다. "나와 당신 사이에 무슨 [상관이 있소]? 당신 아버지의 예언자들과 당신 어머니의 예언자들에게 가시오." 그러자 이스라엘 왕이 그에게 말했다. "아니오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 세 왕을 불러 모압의 손에 넘기시려고 하시기 때문이오."
ko.B: 엘리사가 이스라엘 왕에게 말했다. "나와 당신이 무슨 상관이 있소? 당신 아버지의 예언자들과 당신 어머니의 예언자들에게나 가 보시오." 그러나 이스라엘 왕이 그에게 말했다. "그러지 마시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 세 왕을 불러 모아 모압의 손에 넘기시려고 하시오."
ko.R: 엘리사가 이스라엘 왕에게 말했다. "내가 왜 당신을 도와야 하오? 당신의 아버지와 어머니가 따르던 예언자들에게나 가 보시오!" 그러나 이스라엘 왕이 대답했다. "그러지 마시오! 이 세 왕을 여기까지 끌고 와서 모압에게 지게 하시려는 분이 바로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시오."

pt.B: Eliseu disse ao rei de Israel: "O que eu tenho a ver com você? Vá aos profetas do seu pai e aos profetas da sua mãe." Mas o rei de Israel lhe disse: "Não, pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} chamou estes três reis para entregá-los a Moabe."

decisions.choice: what is there to me and to you?: we have nothing to do with each other
decisions.reason: The question refuses a claim on the speaker (Judges 11:12; 1 Kings 17:18). Elisha owes the king of Israel nothing.

decisions.choice: the prophets of your father and of your mother: the prophets Ahab and Jezebel kept
decisions.reason: Jezebel supported hundreds of prophets of Baal and Asherah (1 Kings 18:19), and Ahab kept four hundred prophets who told him what he wanted to hear (1 Kings 22:6). Elisha tells Jehoram to ask them, since he trusts them.

decisions.choice: no, for: do not send us away, because
decisions.reason: Jehoram does not argue with the charge. His "no" begs Elisha not to refuse, because only Yahweh can help in the trouble he believes Yahweh has brought (verse 10).

decisions.choice: What do you and I have to do with each other? / Why should I help you?
decisions.reason: Balanced turns the idiom into a plain question; Readable gives its point (m1).

decisions.choice: the prophets your father and mother listened to
decisions.reason: Readable joins the two phrases and says what they mean (m2).

decisions.choice: Elisha calls the king "vua" and himself "tôi"; the king calls him "ông"
decisions.reason: As the terms note: prophets call the king "vua", and the king calls a prophet "ông"; Elisha does not use the courtier's "bệ hạ", least of all here.

decisions.choice: Elisha speaks to Jehoram in 하오체 with "당신", and the king answers him in 하오체
alternatives: 합쇼체 to the king, as the terms note's default
decisions.reason: The terms note lets a scene set another level than 합쇼체; Elisha's open contempt for Ahab's son (m1) would sound false in the humble 합쇼체. 하오체 keeps a grown man's courtesy without deference.

decisions.choice: você (Elisha to the king)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: Elisha speaks to the kings of Israel with "você", as Samuel speaks to Saul and the man of God to Jeroboam in Portuguese (1 Samuel 15:17; 1 Kings 13:8); a prophet does not use the courtly "o meu senhor, o rei" of subjects (1 Kings 1:2), and here his words are a rebuke (m1).

records.literal_gloss: And said Elisha, [as] lives Yahweh of hosts, whom I stand before his face, that if not [the] face of Jehoshaphat king of Judah I [am] lifting up, if I would look to you and if I would see you,

en.L: And Elisha said, "[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts lives, before whom I stand, were it not that I lift up the face of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not look at you or see you.
en.B: Elisha said, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies lives, whom I serve, if I did not respect Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not look at you or even notice you.
en.R: Elisha said, "I serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. As surely as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives, I would not even look at you if Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, were not here. I respect him.

es.L: Y dijo Eliseo: «Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, en cuya presencia estoy, que si no fuera porque alzo el rostro de Josafat, rey de Judá, no te miraría ni te vería.
es.B: Eliseo dijo: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, a quien sirvo, si no fuera por respeto a Josafat, rey de Judá, no te miraría ni te prestaría atención.
es.R: Eliseo dijo: «Yo sirvo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Tan cierto como que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vive, ni siquiera te miraría si no estuviera aquí Josafat, el rey de Judá. A él lo respeto.

fr.L: Et Élisée dit : « [Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est vivant, devant qui je me tiens, si je n’avais égard à la face de Josaphat, roi de Juda, je ne te regarderais pas et je ne te verrais pas.
fr.B: Élisée dit : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est vivant, lui que je sers, si je n’avais pas de respect pour Josaphat, roi de Juda, je ne te regarderais même pas, je ne ferais pas attention à toi.
fr.R: Élisée a dit : « Je sers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Aussi vrai qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est vivant, je ne te regarderais même pas si Josaphat, le roi de Juda, n’était pas là. Je le respecte.

sw.L: Elisha akasema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi aishivyo, ambaye nimesimama mbele zake, kama nisingeuinua uso wa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, nisingekutazama wala kukuona.
sw.B: Elisha akasema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi aishivyo, ninayemtumikia, kama nisingemheshimu Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, nisingekutazama wala hata kukujali.
sw.R: Elisha akasema, "Ninamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aishivyo, nisingekutazama hata kidogo kama Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda asingekuwa hapa. Ninamheshimu yeye.

vi.L: Ê-li-sê nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân hằng sống, Đấng tôi đứng chầu trước mặt, nếu tôi không nể mặt Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa, thì tôi đã chẳng nhìn đến vua, cũng chẳng thấy vua.
vi.B: Ê-li-sê nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân hằng sống, Đấng tôi phụng sự, nếu tôi không nể trọng Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa, thì tôi đã chẳng nhìn đến vua, hay để ý đến vua chút nào.
vi.R: Ê-li-sê nói: "Tôi phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân. Thật như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hằng sống, nếu không có Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa ở đây thì tôi đã chẳng thèm nhìn vua. Tôi nể trọng ông ấy.

ko.L: 그러자 엘리사가 말했다. "내가 그 앞에 서 있는 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 [두고 맹세하는데], 내가 유다 왕 여호사밧의 얼굴을 들어 주는 것이 아니라면, 내가 당신을 바라보지도 않고 당신을 보지도 않을 것이오.
ko.B: 엘리사가 말했다. "내가 섬기는 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 내가 유다 왕 여호사밧을 존중하지 않는다면, 당신을 쳐다보지도 않고 거들떠보지도 않을 것이오.
ko.R: 엘리사가 말했다. "나는 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기는 사람이오. 그분께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하오. 유다 왕 여호사밧이 여기 없었다면, 나는 당신을 쳐다보지도 않았을 것이오. 내가 그를 존중하기 때문이오.

pt.L: E Eliseu disse: "[Tão certo como] vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, diante de quem estou, se eu não levantasse o rosto de Josafá, rei de Judá, eu não olharia para você nem o veria.
pt.B: Eliseu disse: "Tão certo como vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, a quem eu sirvo, se eu não respeitasse Josafá, rei de Judá, eu não olharia para você nem lhe daria atenção.
pt.R: Eliseu disse: "Eu sirvo {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. Tão certo como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vive, eu nem olharia para você se Josafá, o rei de Judá, não estivesse aqui. Eu o respeito.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh of hosts lives, before whom I stand: a solemn oath by the one Elisha serves
decisions.reason: Elisha swears in the words Elijah used (1 Kings 17:1; 18:15). To "stand before" someone is to serve him, as an attendant stands ready before a king. "Hosts" means armies: Yahweh rules all the powers of heaven and earth.

decisions.choice: lift up the face of Jehoshaphat: show regard for Jehoshaphat
decisions.reason: To lift someone's face is to receive him with favor. Elisha helps only for the sake of Jehoshaphat, Judah's faithful king (1 Kings 22:43).

decisions.choice: if I would look at you: I would not look at you
decisions.reason: In an oath, "if I do this" leaves a curse unspoken and means "I will not do this" (1 Kings 17:1). Elisha would not so much as look at Jehoram.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts (Literal); the LORD of Armies (Balanced, Readable); before whom I stand / whom I serve
decisions.reason: The oath is worded at each level as in 1 Kings 18:15, where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: respect
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "lift up the face" means (m2). Readable reorders the sentence and puts the reason last to keep it short.

decisions.choice: el SEÑOR de los ejércitos, en cuya presencia estoy (Literal); el SEÑOR de los Ejércitos, a quien sirvo (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note's "el SEÑOR de los ejércitos" (Literal), "de los Ejércitos" (Balanced, Readable); standing before someone means serving him, as Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: alzo el rostro de Josafat
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of lifting up someone's face, that is, showing him regard (m2); Balanced and Readable say "respeto".

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR des armées" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note; French keeps "des armées" at Readable too, since it is the familiar title.

decisions.choice: "BWANA wa majeshi" at every level; "ambaye nimesimama mbele zake" (Literal), "ninayemtumikia" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in the Swahili Samuel drafts, "BWANA wa majeshi" is kept at every level where English Balanced and Readable say "of Armies". Balanced and Readable say what standing before him means.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA Vạn Quân" at every level; "Đấng tôi đứng chầu trước mặt" (L); "Đấng tôi phụng sự" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's title for the LORD of hosts at every level; to stand before a king is to serve him, as Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: "nể mặt"
decisions.reason: "To lift up the face" is to show regard (m2); Vietnamese "nể mặt" keeps a face idiom with the same sense.

decisions.choice: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (L, B), "하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (R); "내가 그 앞에 서 있는" (L), "내가 섬기는" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for "the LORD of hosts"; standing before the LORD means serving him, which Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: "얼굴을 들어 주는" at Literal for "lift up the face"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, which the meaning decision explains (m2); Balanced and Readable say "존중하다".

decisions.choice: o SENHOR dos Exércitos (every level); diante de quem estou (L), a quem eu sirvo (B, R)
decisions.reason: "O SENHOR dos Exércitos" is the Old Testament terms' wording at every level, where the English says "hosts" at Literal and "Armies" at Balanced and Readable (m1). Elisha swears in Elijah's words (1 Kings 17:1; 18:15), and their Portuguese is meant to be the same: "diante de quem estou" at Literal, keeping the picture of standing before a king, and "a quem eu sirvo" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: a musician: someone who plays a stringed instrument
decisions.reason: The verb means to play on strings, as David played the lyre for Saul (1 Samuel 16:16, 23). Music went with prophecy in Israel (1 Samuel 10:5; 1 Chronicles 25:1).

decisions.choice: the hand of Yahweh came on him: Yahweh's power took hold of him to speak
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power. The phrase is used when Yahweh moves a prophet to act or to receive a message (1 Kings 18:46; Ezekiel 1:3). The message follows in verse 16.

decisions.choice: the power of the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable says what the hand stands for (m2).

decisions.choice: Elisha

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 능력" at Readable for "the hand of the LORD"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, the picture of the hand is given its sense, Yahweh's power.
